summary: Sun Life Financial Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second-quarter 2026 earnings press release dated August 6, 2026. The report details financial results: underlying net income of $1,123 million (up 11% YoY), reported net income of $1,008 million (up 41%), underlying EPS of $2.02 (up 13%), and underlying ROE of 19.1%. AUM reached $1,696 billion, up 10% YoY. The filing is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or capital actions. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are present. This is a standard quarterly results update for a foreign private issuer, not an event-driven special situation.
